refund.title: Refund Policy
refund.intro: This policy covers Doppler VPN purchases from SIMNETIQ LTD (company number 16861177), 2 Frederick Street, Kings Cross, London, WC1X 0ND, United Kingdom. Website access is a one-time payment. App Store and Google Play plans renew until you cancel them in the store.

euRights.title: 1. EU/EEA cancellation (14 days)
euRights.content: If you are a consumer in the European Union or the EEA, you can cancel within 14 days without giving a reason. Email support@simnetiq.com before the 14 days end. We refund the amount you paid. We do not deduct the payment processor's fee. A deduction for service already used is not automatic. Purchases from the App Store or Google Play are requested from that store.

ukRights.title: 2. UK cancellation (14 days)
ukRights.content: If you are a consumer in the United Kingdom, you have a 14-day cancellation right under the Consumer Contracts (Information, Cancellation and Additional Charges) Regulations 2013. Email support@simnetiq.com with a clear statement. We refund the amount you paid and we do not deduct the payment processor's fee. A deduction for service already used is not automatic, and connecting once is not by itself a reason to refuse.

goodwill.title: 3. 30-day goodwill refund
goodwill.content: For customers outside the EU/EEA and the UK, the published goodwill refund is 30 days from the first purchase, once per customer. Promotional or discounted purchases are excluded unless the law requires otherwise. When that refund is granted, it is for the amount you paid. Email support@simnetiq.com with your Account ID and order reference.

revolutCard.title: 4. Website card payments
revolutCard.content: Card payments on the website, including Apple Pay and Google Pay on that page, are processed by Revolut. They are not App Store or Google Play purchases. Email support@simnetiq.com with your Account ID and order reference. Do not send the card number. This policy does not deduct the processor's fee. Your bank decides when a credit appears.

oxapay.title: 5. Crypto payments (OxaPay)
oxapay.content: Crypto payments on the website are processed by OxaPay. Email support@simnetiq.com with your Account ID, invoice reference, coin, and network. We will not guess the sending address. Tell us the wallet address to use. We confirm the asset, network, and amount before a refund is sent. This policy does not keep network fees or a change in price as a deduction.

appStore.title: 6. App Store
appStore.content: Apple decides App Store refunds. We cannot promise approval or a number of days. Use the links below. Email support@simnetiq.com if you want help finding your Account ID.

googlePlay.title: 7. Google Play
googlePlay.content: Google decides Google Play refunds. Eligibility depends on the product, how long ago you paid, the country, and the reason. We do not turn one published time window into a refusal, and we cannot promise approval. Use the link below, or email support@simnetiq.com if you want help with your Account ID.

renewals.title: 8. Renewals
renewals.content: A website purchase covers the period you chose. It does not auto-renew, and there is no renewal charge to refund. An App Store or Google Play plan renews until you cancel it in that store, at least 24 hours before the period ends. Access lasts until the period ends. If a store charged a renewal you did not want, contact us within 14 days and we will help you ask the store. The store decides.

exclusions.title: 9. Exclusions
exclusions.content: A goodwill refund can be refused if the request is late, the account was closed for breaking the Terms, the same customer asks again, or the purchase was promotional or discounted. None of this removes a statutory right. A payment processor's fee is not a reason to refuse or reduce a refund.

howTo.title: 10. How to ask
howTo.content: Send your Account ID, where you paid (website card, crypto, App Store, or Google Play), the order or invoice reference, and the date. A reason is optional. Email support@simnetiq.com. Do not send a card number, a wallet seed, or a private key. We aim to acknowledge a website request within 2 business days. Your bank, the store, or the network decides when money appears.

contact.title: 11. Contact
contact.content: SIMNETIQ LTD, 2 Frederick Street, Kings Cross, London, WC1X 0ND, United Kingdom. Email: support@simnetiq.com. EU consumers can also use the European Commission's online dispute resolution platform at https://ec.europa.eu/consumers/odr.

helpAccountId.title: Account ID and recovery
helpAccountId.intro: A Doppler account is an anonymous Account ID. It is not an email login, and the language of the app is not the country where you live.

what.title: What the Account ID is
what.content: The ID looks like VPN-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX. The app creates it on first launch. The website can also create it at checkout. Find it under Profile or Settings, then Account. Use the same ID on every device, and keep it private. Support will not ask for your card number.

recovery.title: If you lose it
recovery.content: If you linked an email, open Support and choose Restore account. We send the ID to that email. If you linked nothing, open a support request. Pasting an ID does not by itself prove that you own the account.

language.title: Language is not residence
language.content: Russian, or any other language, does not tell us which country you live in or whether a sanctions rule applies to you.

deletion.title: Deleting an account
deletion.content: Delete account, in the app or on the delete-account page, removes the whole Doppler account. It does not remove only a support contact. Paid access has to end or be cancelled first. There is no separate public page yet for removing only a support contact.

helpWebAndStore.title: Website access and store subscriptions
helpWebAndStore.intro: Where you paid decides whether access renews and who can refund it.

web.title: One-time website access
web.content: The website charges once for the period you choose: a month, 6 months, or a year. It does not auto-renew and it does not keep a card for a later charge. Card payments use Revolut. Crypto payments use OxaPay. The Windows app and the Android APK are bought on the website.

wallets.title: Apple Pay and Google Pay on the website
wallets.content: Apple Pay and Google Pay on the website are wallets on the card checkout. They are not App Store or Google Play subscriptions.

stores.title: App Store and Google Play
stores.content: Those stores sell auto-renewing subscriptions. New store customers get a 3-day trial. Cancel in the store at least 24 hours before renewal. One store subscription attaches Pro to one Account ID at a time.

notSold.title: What we do not sell
notSold.content: There is no Telegram Stars purchase, no Microsoft Store purchase, and no balance top-up. The Windows app is a direct installer.

helpRestoreCancelRefund.title: Restore, cancel, or refund
helpRestoreCancelRefund.intro: Restore, cancel, and refund do different things.

restore.title: Restore
restore.content: Restore puts access you already paid for onto an Account ID. In the App Store or Google Play app, open Profile, Subscription, then Restore Purchases. Restoring on a different Account ID moves Pro to that account. A website purchase shows up when the app is signed in with the Account ID used at checkout. Restart the app if it does not show yet. The APK has no Restore Purchases button.

cancel.title: Cancel
cancel.content: Cancel stops the next store renewal. It does not by itself return money. On iPhone, open Settings, your name, Subscriptions, Doppler VPN, then Cancel. On Android, open the Play Store, your profile, Payments and subscriptions, Subscriptions, then Cancel. A website purchase does not renew, so there is nothing to cancel.

refund.title: Refund
refund.content: A refund asks for the money back. The Refund Policy has the steps for a website card, crypto, the App Store, and Google Play. Do not send a card number.

Google Play refunds go through Google. For a website card or crypto payment, contact support with your Account ID and order reference. Do not send a card number.

supportContact.title: Support contact and account deletion
supportContact.content: Linking an email or Telegram for recovery or support is not the same as deleting your account. The delete-account page deletes the Doppler account. It does not remove only a support contact. Payment records may be kept where the law requires it. There is no separate public page for removing only a support contact.
